caseName: Morris Plan Industrial Bank v. Graves
caseNameFull: Morris Plan Industrial Bank of New York v. Graves, Constituting the State Tax Commission of the State of New York
attorneys: Mr. B. Randolph Hicks for appellant. Messrs. John J. Bennett, Jr., Attorney General of New York, and Wendell P. Brown, Assistant Attorney General, for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a final judgment of the highest court of the State on the constitutional question presented.

The Chief Justice took no part in this decision.
